issues.summary: Motor centers are a symmetric-X visualization proxy
issues.evidence: Source Two is described as stretched; exact motor XY must come from original CAD.
issues.action: Import the original CAD, extract the motor centers, and record their drawing revision.

issues.summary: Propeller tip envelope is inferred from model name
issues.evidence: T5143S product name is not dimensional inspection.
issues.action: Measure the actual tip-to-tip diameter and fixture/hub stack-up.

issues.evidence: V2207 technical drawing and frame DXF mounting interfaces have not been compared.
issues.action: Inspect both mechanical drawings and motor fastener lengths.

issues.summary: Propeller hub and motor shaft interface is not qualified
issues.evidence: Published 4mm motor shaft does not establish prop hub mating features.
issues.action: Inspect original prop and motor drawings; check retention system.

issues.summary: Reference SpeedyBee F405 V5 stack is discontinued
issues.evidence: Manufacturer explicitly labels its product discontinued.
issues.action: Record a specific available replacement SKU and obtain its exact manufacturer documentation.

issues.summary: Battery is an unqualified 6S mass assumption
issues.evidence: No actual battery manufacturer, pack current rating, size, chemistry, connector, or BMS/charger specification.
issues.action: Specify the exact pack SKU and inspect its datasheet.

issues.summary: Accessories and assembly mass are assumptions
issues.evidence: Video/radio/antenna/wires/fasteners masses are not measured as an integrated aircraft.
issues.action: Weigh the revision-specific parts and complete BOM.

issues.evidence: Even known component masses cannot substitute for a measured assembled aircraft.
issues.action: Weigh the assembled aircraft with actual battery/props/camera.

issues.summary: Radio, receiver, failsafe and ground link are unspecified
issues.evidence: No controls/receiver/firmware pairing or link-loss bench evidence.
issues.action: Specify exact control link and test failsafe props-off.

issues.evidence: U.S. recreational flight may require TRUST, FAA registration and Remote ID.
issues.action: Review current FAA and local airspace rules for actual aircraft/operation.

issues.summary: Gazebo thrust/torque coefficients and inertias are missing
issues.evidence: Bench thrust table alone is not a calibrated model; there is no measured inertia or dynamic actuator response.
issues.action: Measure mass properties and identify motor kT/kQ and spin-up dynamics; then calibrate SITL.

assumptions: Symmetric X geometry is a proxy, not exact Source Two CAD
Mass estimate combines manufacturer subset and user inputs
Bench thrust data at specified conditions cannot predict flight time
Physical verification and valid operating authorization are always required
